usage: 啟動 (kai2 dung6) is a verb that means to start or activate a machine, device, or system.
It is commonly used when turning on electronic devices or starting software programs.
啟動 can also refer to the initiation of a process or action.
This word is usually followed by the object being started without any connectors.
The past tense can be indicated by context or with helper words like '咗' (zo2).

examples.jyutping: ngo5 kai2 dung6 zo2 din6 nou5.
cing2 kai2 dung6 hai6 tung2 sin1.
san1 gei1 kai2 dung6 dak1 gei2 faai3.
examples.meaning: The new machine starts quite quickly.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 kai2 dung6 zo2 gung1 san1 sing4 coeng4.
